description.value: Mi Tierra Latina (listed in OSM as My Latin American Grocery Store) is a specialty Latin American grocery stocking authentic products from nine countries — Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, El Salvador, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Venezuela. The store carries a broad range of packaged goods including beverages, sauces, corn and bean products, frozen food, snacks, and spices. A touring cyclist passing through North Vancouver could use it as a food resupply point for specialty and everyday pantry staples.
